text: Does anyone have experience with renewing or reapplying for a tourist visa after one expires? PIBA won't give me any straight answers about the process. If someone with a tourist visa leaves Israel before is expires (i.e. makes sure to not overstay) do they need to reapply for an ETA-IL online? Can they go and come back within a certain timeframe? I need to line up a plan b in case they do not grant an extension, but that needs to include a way to come back to Israel.
